channel.title: How are the Contests Chosen and Decided Exactly?
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "How are the Contests Chosen and Decided Exactly?" - Who makes the decisions on contests? The admins?

item.title: Re: How are the Contests Chosen and Decided Exactly?
item.content:encoded: Though Workshops and Seminars is an Outreach Project, the contests are picked by different staff. If you have any questions you can hop onto #site81 on irc.

item.title: Re: How are the Contests Chosen and Decided Exactly?
item.content:encoded: I see, and by community outreach, you mean on IRC and the workshops right?

item.title: Re: How are the Contests Chosen and Decided Exactly?
item.content:encoded: Community Outreach typically decides the contests. We have a few ideas for several contests at a time and they are scheduled throughout the year, except for Kcons. Kcons happen when there are few slots left in the current series.

item.title: How are the Contests Chosen and Decided Exactly?
item.content:encoded: I'm just inquiring on how the contests are actually decided. Not the winners of these contents, but rather how is theme and rules are chosen for each one. Are the admins in charge of that or is there some other process I'm not aware of?
